name: Grunt
one_liner: Configuration-driven task runner from the era before bundlers absorbed the build.
what_it_is: A task runner configured through a large declarative object, orchestrating plugins for concatenation, minification, linting and file watching by writing intermediate files to disk between steps.
why_it_matters: Grunt and Gulp defined a whole era of frontend work that has since been absorbed: bundlers took over the build graph, and framework tooling took over the rest. It is here because recognising a Gruntfile immediately dates a codebase, and because it is a concrete reminder that today's default build tool is also temporary.
not_suitable_for: Teams without existing Grunt expertise to maintain it
